name: audio-description
useCase: Indicate an audio-described track or an audio description setting.
misuse: Do not use this mark for ordinary audio playback or subtitles.

16.reason: Upright A and D letterforms have open counters and distinct spacing. Two rounded sound waves increase in height without crowding the larger letters.

24.reason: The larger letters and two rounded sound waves share a centered composition. Their separate counters and clear audio cue remain legible beside text.
